page.summary: Stay productive without starting chase, spend stealth layers deliberately, and switch to ordinary escape or team coverage when the Killer has found the route.

verdict.recommendation: Use stealth to preserve objective and rescue tempo, not to avoid every risk; choose the layer that matches your current health, movement and task.
verdict.soloQ: Pre-position for a productive job and track teammate pressure yourself; when the team needs a rescue or the Killer has your trail, stop immersing and act.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Call who is taking pressure and who is covering the objective so stealth does not silently shift the Killer's work onto teammates.
verdict.mainWeakness: The Killer can bypass a selected stealth layer, tokens and state gates can leave it inactive, and prolonged avoidance can transfer pressure to the team.

plans.label: Stealth and chase-avoidance module
plans.why: The source gives a strategy framework rather than a verified four-perk build. Keep aura denial and one noise or trace layer as choices that fit the actual Trial state.

choices.whyItsHere: Spend a token to block a Killer Aura read and suppress Scratch Marks briefly, then treat the remaining tokens as a finite resource.

slots.role: Choose a noise or trace layer

choices.whyItsHere: Suppress Crows and screams while making Chest and Totem interactions silent, which supports quiet objective routing.
Reduce injured Grunts of Pain while not Exhausted when the stealth plan must continue after a hit.
Suppress running footsteps while healthy, then respect its Rushed Vault cooldown instead of treating it as permanent quiet movement.

opening: Choose a productive job and a route that keeps a teammate's rescue or generator coverage visible. Stealth is successful when it prevents a chase while the team still advances, not when it only delays contact.

rows.situation: You have Distortion tokens and are travelling through an area where an Aura read could start chase.
rows.action: Use the blocked-read window to reach the planned job or break line of sight. Count the token loss and do not linger as though the concealment will refresh without another chase condition.
rows.why: Distortion has limited tokens, suppresses Scratch Marks only for its brief effect and does not trigger while Dying.

rows.situation: You are choosing how to stay quiet while moving to an objective, Chest or Totem, or after taking a hit.
rows.action: Use Calm Spirit for quiet Crow, scream, Chest or Totem interactions; use Iron Will only while injured and not Exhausted; use Light-Footed only while healthy and off its Rushed Vault cooldown.
rows.why: These perks cover different noise and state conditions. None makes every movement or interaction invisible.

rows.situation: The Killer is elsewhere and a generator, rescue route or useful interaction can be completed without drawing attention.
rows.action: Take the productive action and pre-plan the exit before the Killer arrives. Do not crouch or detour solely to preserve an unused stealth state when the team needs progress.
rows.why: The strategy's payoff is staying productive while avoiding attention; avoidance without team value is only delayed pressure.

rows.situation: A teammate is in danger, the Killer has found your route or the stealth layer has gone inactive.
rows.action: Switch to the needed rescue, objective handoff or ordinary escape route. Call the change in a coordinated team and do not make teammates absorb the pressure silently.
rows.why: Teammate state and game state are canonical dependencies, so an individual stealth plan cannot outrank an uncovered team job.

rows.situation: The Killer tracks through the selected layer or chase has already started.
rows.action: Stop trying to remain immersed and use the best available chase route. After the contact ends, resume productive stealth only from a safe position.
rows.why: C07 prevents chase from starting; once that boundary is missed it is not the same plan as a chase-reset package.

abortWhen: Abort the stealth detour when an urgent rescue or generator is uncovered, even if the selected layer is still available.
Release the avoidance plan when the Killer has your position or the route has forced you into chase; transition to survival and team coverage.

soloQ: Keep the nearest rescue and generator in view; no teammate can be assumed to understand why you are avoiding contact or to cover the pressure you leave behind.
coordinatedSwf: Name the job you are quietly covering and the point where you will take or hand off pressure so stealth does not create a silent gap in team coverage.

strengths: Stay productive while avoiding Killer attention when the route and team state support it.
weaknesses: The Killer can track through the chosen stealth layer or force pressure onto teammates.
Health, Exhausted state, cooldowns and limited Distortion tokens can remove the layer at the moment it is expected.
killerCounterplay: The Killer can use a different tracking method, change targets or pressure the team until avoiding chase costs more than taking the required action.
commonMistakes: Treating one aura or noise layer as full invisibility across every health and game state.
Staying hidden while an urgent rescue or generator is uncovered and shifting pressure onto teammates.
Continuing the immersion plan after the Killer has found the route instead of switching to an ordinary escape.
